mapper.select: SELECT device_type_id,name FROM device_type WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY name

SELECT f.fault_type_id,f.device_type_id,f.name,d.name device_name FROM fault_type f JOIN device_type d ON d.device_type_id=f.device_type_id WHERE f.status='ACTIVE' AND d.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY d.name,f.name
SELECT service_area_id,name FROM service_area WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY name
SELECT f.fault_type_id FROM fault_type f WHERE f.fault_type_id=#{faultId} AND f.device_type_id=#{deviceId} AND f.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT rr.*,dt.name device_name,ft.name fault_name,sa.name area_name FROM repair_request rr JOIN device_type dt ON dt.device_type_id=rr.device_type_id JOIN fault_type ft ON ft.fault_type_id=rr.fault_type_id JOIN service_area sa ON sa.service_area_id=rr.service_area_id WHERE rr.repair_request_id=#{requestId} AND rr.customer_id=#{customerId}
